description: Use this for a cheap copy-trade screen before paying for a full profile. Cheap copy-trade screen for one wallet: windowed realized PnL, win rate, closed trades, last active time, bot, exchange, net-winner and dormant flags, plus copyTradeScore and copyTradeGrade (copy-return after a 3s delay and a 3.6% round trip, win rate, sample-size shrinkage, bot and insider penalties). Free teaser at /wallet/preview; full report at /wallet/profile. Costs $0.002 USDC (2000 base units) via x402. The same price is charged for HTTP GET /wallet/quick. An unpaid HTTP call returns 402 even when the query is missing or invalid. A signed call with invalid arguments is rejected before settlement and is not charged. A successful result can set cached, stale, and cacheAgeMs. stale true means a previous result was served while a refresh runs or the upstream failed. You are charged only when the tool result is not an error.
